messages:
nina: Quick broadcast  holding the release train due to an unexpected internal cert rotation that caused failed TLS handshakes with several inference frontends in us-east-1. Estimated hold 12-24h while we complete a controlled roll and validate handshakes. Please pause new train submissions for the next hour. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] health-alert: TLS handshake failures observed across 6/18 frontends in us-east-1. See: https://infra.internal/tls-rollout

ops: Root cause = automated cert rotation that missed a subset of edge proxies. Mitigation in progress: targeted proxy restart + staged cert re-apply. Were starting the first wave now.

eli: If teams need an exception for a critical hotfix, what's the process?

nina: @eli  exceptions allowed only for P0 regressions. Open a release-exception issue on the release-train board, tag @nina + @ops. Include customer impact and artifact build id. We aim to respond within 30m.

sara: New temporary governance rule (effective now): trains will auto-abort if smoke tests fail for >2 distinct services for 5m during rollout. This prevents cascading deploys with broken infra dependencies. Exceptions must be documented in the exception issue.

adrian: Will Dedicated/reserved pools be impacted? Our enterprise customers expect committed latency.

ops: Reserved Dedicated pools are not affected by the proxy certs as they terminate at dedicated load balancers with their own cert sets. However, any shared routing through the affected proxies may see transient failures. If you rely on guaranteed throughput, file infra-alloc and tag @ops. :eyes:

nina: For canary reassignments: non-data-local canaries will be migrated to eu-west-1 temporarily. If your canary requires us-east-1-specific datasets, mark the canary ticket with `data:local-only` and we will not move it. Owners of moved canaries will get a DM from the bot.

deploy-bot: Helpful commands:
```
rictl proxy status --region=us-east-1
rictl canary migrate --id=<id> --target=eu-west-1
```

eli: Timeline question: after the cert re-apply wave completes, how long until we resume the train?

ops: We'll run a 30m validation window after the rolling cert patch. If no handshake regressions reappear, we'll resume incremental ramping. Nina will post a resume or extend decision after the validation window.

nina: Posting an update in ~45m after the first validation wave. Thanks for standing down PR merges for now and for the quick coordination. Please raise any urgent exception requests here. :thumbsup:
